# Native FlashVSR+ standalone setup

Connect WeeToddCLI, existing FFmpeg/FFprobe and the source movie. Select Swift/MLX, Turbo or Base, and Tiny or Full Wan VAE. The vpipe field can remain empty for native execution. Historical API prompts without a backend retain legacy vpipe selection.

Use Studio’s Model setup or `WeeToddCLI models download` to acquire checksum-pinned components into the shared AI model library. Compatible installed files are reused. Setup, archive conversion and inference use Swift/MLX; no Python model environment is required.

This portable workflow needs local paths before queueing. Source FPS/audio and exact target dimensions are preserved. See studio/FLASHVSR_SETTINGS.md.

Official model source: https://huggingface.co/ruchangyao/FlashVSR_plus

Queue the workflow only after connecting local paths. ComfyUI/models/ may link to the shared model library; keep weights out of project checkouts.
